verses.text: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices. They were going to put them on Jesus' body.
Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
They asked each other, "Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb for us?"
It was a very large stone. But when they looked up, they saw that it had already been rolled away.
As they went into the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side. They were alarmed.
"Do not be alarmed," he said. "You are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was nailed to a cross. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.
But go and tell his followers and Peter, 'He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.'"
The women went out and ran away from the tomb. They were shaking and confused. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid.
Early on the first day of the week, after Jesus rose from the dead, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene. He had driven seven demons out of her.
She went and told those who had been with him. They were sad and crying.
When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.
After that, Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking out into the country.
They went back and told the others. But the others did not believe them either.
Later Jesus appeared to the eleven while they were eating. He scolded them because they had no faith. Their hearts were hard, because they did not believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the good news to everyone.
Whoever believes and is baptised will be saved. But whoever does not believe will be judged guilty.
These signs will go with those who believe. In my name they will drive out demons. They will speak in new languages.
They will pick up snakes with their hands. When they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all. They will put their hands on sick people, and the sick people will get well."
After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven. He sat down at the right side of God.
Then the followers went out and preached everywhere. The Lord worked with them, and he showed that their message was true by the signs that went with it. Amen.
